source_authors: PolyAI; Casanueva, Temcinas, Gerz, Henderson and Vulic (2020)
selection: For each predeclared category, take the ten original test texts with smallest SHA256(seed + text). No translation, rewriting, training split, tuning or post-result exclusion.
scope: External-source English bank-support queries mapped to broad application routes; not the original 77-way benchmark, Chinese workflow assessment, independent assessor certification or real fraud evaluation.
